The '''Ziost Liberation Front''', or '''ZLF''' or '''Ziost Front''', was a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization active on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Galactic War]]. They hoped to liberate their home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
